result.title: FLUID: Flexible, Evidence-Grounded Situated Task Guidance
result.summary: Real-time task guidance is inherently flexible: when an agent guides a user through a task, multiple responses and timings can be appropriate, and sometimes the best action is to remain silent. Existing benchmarks often miss this flexibility by treating synthesized dialogues as fixed targets for what to say and when to say it. We introduce FLUID (Flexible, Evidence-Grounded Situated Task Guidance), a unified framework for modeling, evaluating, and enabling flexible interaction in multimodal task guidance. Using naturally occurring human-human guidance from WTaG and HoloAssist, FLUID grounds interventions in their supporting evidence, necessity, and timing flexibility, and uses this representation both to evaluate flexible guidance and to build a real-time agent for task guidance. Our agent achieves the strongest overall balance of response correctness, intervention precision, timely guidance, and response latency among evaluated systems, while still leaving room for improvement in avoiding speech overlap. Together, FLUID moves situated task guidance beyond rigid reference matching toward more natural and adaptive human-AI interaction. Project page: https://fluid-guidance.github.io.

AI.brief_summary: 基于 WTaG 与 HoloAssist 的真实人类指导数据，提出 FLUID 框架：把多模态任务指导中的干预与支撑证据、必要性及时间灵活性关联起来，既用于评测灵活指导，也用于构建实时指导 agent。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「何时发言、何时保持沉默」的证据驱动干预判定与实时延迟权衡，可能为 LVR 的 STOP 决策和视觉证据筛选提供评测协议上的线索，但该工作聚焦交互式任务指导而非内部 latent 推理状态，联系需核查。
